mathover.matchPreset.title: Match Preset
enumDescriptions: Use custom regex from matchRegex setting

mathover.matchRegex.title: Custom Match Regex
mathover.matchRegex.description: Custom regex with capture group(s) for LaTeX content. Only used when matchPreset is 'custom'.

mathover.matchRegexFlags.title: Custom Match Regex Flags
mathover.matchRegexFlags.description: Flags for custom match regex. Only used when matchPreset is 'custom'.

mathover.enabledLanguages.title: Enabled Languages
mathover.enabledLanguages.description: Language IDs to turn back on. Some languages are disabled by default because `$` is common there (e.g. powershell, shellscript, php) or math already renders (markdown). Enable them at your own risk. Takes priority over disabledLanguages.

mathover.disabledLanguages.title: Disabled Languages
mathover.disabledLanguages.description: Additional language IDs to disable Mathover in, on top of the built-in defaults.

mathover.inlineDisplay.title: Inline Display (Experimental)
mathover.inlineDisplay.description: Experimental: also render each formula inline after its match, without hovering. Alignment and spacing are rough.

mathover.updateInterval.title: Update Interval
mathover.updateInterval.description: Number of milliseconds between decoration updates.

mathover.svgTextColorLight.title: SVG Text Color (Light Theme)
mathover.svgTextColorLight.description: Text color of hover image in light themes. Set to 'auto' to match theme.

mathover.svgTextColorDark.title: SVG Text Color (Dark Theme)
mathover.svgTextColorDark.description: Text color of hover image in dark themes. Set to 'auto' to match theme.

mathover.svgBackgroundColorLight.title: SVG Background Color (Light Theme)
mathover.svgBackgroundColorLight.description: Background color of hover image in light themes. Set to 'auto' for transparent.

mathover.svgBackgroundColorDark.title: SVG Background Color (Dark Theme)
mathover.svgBackgroundColorDark.description: Background color of hover image in dark themes. Set to 'auto' for transparent.

mathover.correctDecorationType.title: Correct Decoration Type
mathover.correctDecorationType.description: Decoration style for correct syntax matches.

mathover.wrongDecorationType.title: Wrong Decoration Type
mathover.wrongDecorationType.description: Decoration style for wrong syntax matches.
